title: Tributary structured log line, v0
description: One JSON object per line on stderr, as written by tributary.runtime.logs.JsonLogger. See README.md section 4. Field names are snake_case codes; values are scalars, bounded, single-line. A field name that denotes a direct identifier or carries content is refused (invariant 6). This RAISES THE COST of logging PHI; it does not make it impossible, so code review and security-reviewer remain the control.

allOf.$comment: Direct identifiers: byte-for-byte the events/v0 attrs deny-list and tributary.sdk.guards.IDENTIFIER_NAMES.
Content and free-text carriers (new in observability/v0). Exception text quotes the offending field value; a payload or body is PHI by default.

tb_msg_id.$comment: DEPRECATED alias of message_id (receivers, wave 2). Accepted in v0; new code writes message_id.

msg_id.$comment: DEPRECATED alias of message_id (receivers/reply, wave 2). Accepted in v0; new code writes message_id.

error.$comment: An exception CLASS name (safe_token(type(exc).__name__)), never str(exc).

additionalProperties.$comment: Scalars only, at most 256 characters, no CR or LF (a newline forges a second log line). Same rules as tributary.sdk.guards.validate_log_field.
